_comment_1: Copy this file, rename it, edit it, then run:  npm run listing:add -- data/listings/your-file.json
_comment_2: Add --publish to go live. Without it, the listing is saved as a draft and is not visible to anyone.
_comment_slug: Becomes the public URL: /listings/14-oak-street/. Lowercase, hyphens only. Treat as permanent once published — changing it 404s every link you've shared.
description: A four-bedroom colonial on a quarter-acre lot, two blocks from the Delaware River waterfront. The kitchen was renovated in 2024 with quartz counters and a gas range. The primary bedroom is on the first floor. Natural gas heat, central air, two-car garage with interior access.
_comment_highlights: Short factual bullets. DESCRIBE THE PROPERTY, NEVER THE PERSON — the script blocks Fair Housing problems before anything is written.
highlights: Two blocks from the Delaware River waterfront
_comment_images: Full URLs. First image is used as the hero and as the social-share preview.
_comment_attribution: is_own_listing false = another broker's listing. Publishing one then REQUIRES listing_brokerage and permission_confirmed — NJ requires the listing broker be identified, and permission to advertise it at all.
_comment_sold: Only for status sold — set these and the page renders as social proof instead of an active listing.
